exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) with good glycemic control
outcome: Differently expressed metabolites (DEMs) in maternal plasma
Metabolism in subcutaneous white adipose tissue (sWAT)
Metabolism in omental white adipose tissue (oWAT)
cohort: The study included pregnant women with scheduled caesarean sections, comparing those with gestational diabetes (with good glycemic control) to healthy pregnancies.
finding: The study found that subcutaneous white adipose tissue (sWAT) compensates for perturbations in circulating one-carbon metabolism (OCM) associated with GDM by boosting methionine cycle, NAD+ metabolism, and adipogenesis.
cross-section timing: On the day prior to and at the time of delivery
